svg.aria-label: The up-sweep of the Blelloch scan on 3, 1, 7, 0, 4, 1, 6, 3. Distance 1: elements 1, 3, 5, 7 become 4, 7, 5, 9. Distance 2: elements 3 and 7 become 11 and 14. Distance 4: element 7 becomes 25. The small labels give the range each cell sums.
svg.text: 7 additions leave the sums of ranges of length 1, 2, 4 and 8 in place.
Element i = 2 · distance - 1, 4 · distance - 1, ... adds element i - distance.
4 + 2 + 1 = 7 additions build a tree of partial sums; element 7 ends with 25.
